status: SPECIFIED, NOT CREATED. No Azure resource, identity, role definition or role assignment exists, and none was created or queried. Placeholders in angle brackets must be filled by the owner after decision D-037 (subscription and tenant) and the sign-in approval (TODO T11, T13). Role names and action strings must be verified against current Azure documentation before use; this file asserts nothing about what a role currently permits.
principles: One identity per permission tier. A tier-0 reader can never write, and a deployer can never grant roles
No standing identity for P4. Sensitive operations are done by a named human with their own identity, under the P4 workflow
Scopes are resource groups in non-production only. Never a subscription, management group, tenant root or any production scope
No stored secret. Use short-lived tokens through workload identity federation or a managed identity
Destructive actions are removed from the custom role and also blocked by a resource lock, so one mistake in either layer is not enough
Role assignment writes, policy writes and secret reads are excluded from every agent identity

identities.purpose: Read-only diagnostics of non-production resources (Azure Resource Graph, Monitor, Application Insights)
identities.credential: workload identity federation or managed identity; no stored secret
identities.enabledBy: owner approval of Azure sign-in (T11) and a per-agent ceiling change in permissions.json

identities.purpose: Deploy reviewed infrastructure to non-production only while a signed P3 approval is valid
identities.credential: assigned for the approval's lifetime and removed afterwards; no stored secret

customRole.Name: Harness Nonprod Deployer
customRole.Description: Deploy and update reviewed resources in one non-production resource group. Cannot delete, cannot change authorisation, cannot read secrets.

identities.enabledBy: owner approval, a reviewed what-if for a specific commit, and a signed P3 approval (approval.mjs)

identities.purpose: Deletion, role changes, policy changes, secret access and anything in production
identities.credential: none for agents. A named human uses their own identity and the break-glass or P4 procedure

forbidden.forbiddenNote: Contributor is forbidden as a built-in role because it can delete. The P3 identity uses the custom role above instead.
